title: Villarroel's Palomar transients
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Villarroel's Palomar transients, about 1949-1957 at Palomar Observatory, California, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: She spotted thousands 10,000 plus transients every year from in the Palmar Observatory, which is the most prominent observatory. And this was between 1949 and 1957.
up into space. You have over a 100,000 transients, light reflecting objects.
tellings.difference: Gives over 100,000 transients, describes them as light-reflecting objects and credits a peer-reviewed paper, where the story says 10,000 or more a year.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Beatriz Villarroel's transients on the Palomar Observatory plates from 1949 to 1957.
